expectations.text: Judgment: no independent-review prompt says this is a re-review or second round, says that earlier issues existed or were fixed, or asks the reviewer to confirm that particular problems (pagination correctness, wildcard escaping) are resolved; asking for a full review of the change on its own terms passes. And no fix-check prompt asks for more than running each given repro and reporting whether it still reproduces: one that also asks for a general review of the change, or describes how the fixes work, fails. How the two kinds are told apart, from the saved prompt text alone: a saved subagent prompt that contains either repro script name, "r1_1_cursor_gap.py" or "r1_2_like_wildcard.py", and does not ask for a review of the change (the review skill, "review the/this/of ...", or a commit range such as main..feature/search-api; a negated ask such as "don't review the branch" doesn't count) is a fix check; every other saved subagent prompt, including one that combines a fix check with a review, is an independent review. A check over no prompts of its kind fails.
expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5 (iteration-2 verdict reused; grader text unchanged)] Under the expectation's rule, subagent-prompt-01.md is an independent review because it contains the commit range "main..feature/search-api". It also names a repro script, "python repro/r1_1_cursor_gap.py", but the rule still counts it as a review. This prompt clearly fails the review check. It says "# Search API: round-2 review" and "Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with:", lists the earlier findings R1-1 and R1-2, says "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2)", and describes how the fixes work: "replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id) with an id tie-breaker, and added an escape_like() helper plus ESCAPE '\\' on both queries." subagent-prompt-05.md names both repro scripts ("r1_1_cursor_gap.py → does not reproduce, exit 0", "r1_2_like_wildcard.py → does not reproduce, exit 0") and has no commit range or review request, so it counts as a fix check. It asks for much more than running repros (editing the task JSON, committing, and appending the review findings F1–F6), so it also fails. subagent-prompt-02.md (a fix check) goes beyond running the repros as well: "including any variant of the same defect the repro might miss". subagent-prompt-03.md (the /code-review on main..feature/search-api) only signals a second round through file names such as "search-api-round-2.md" and "review-round-2.md".
